title: PC Cleanup, Bloatware, and Adware Review
description: Review disk pressure, temp files, startup clutter, unwanted apps, and browser/proxy adware clues before approved cleanup and verification.
starter_prompt: Clean up this PC and review bloatware or adware. Start read-only, show findings, use Windows/SAK built-in tools first, do not remove user data or apps without approval, verify afterward, and report.

phases.prompt: Confirm cleanup scope. State that safe temp/component cleanup can be approved in this workflow, but application removal and browser/profile resets require a separate explicit approval for exact targets.
phases.completion: Cleanup scope and safety limits are clear.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; function Section($n){ Write-Output ('== ' + $n + ' ==') }; function TrySection($n,[scriptblock]$b){ Section $n; try { & $b } catch { Write-Output ('[warning] ' + $n + ' unavailable: ' + $_.Exception.Message) } }; $dism=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\Dism.exe'; TrySection 'Volumes' { Get-Volume | Select-Object DriveLetter,FileSystemLabel,FileSystem,HealthStatus,OperationalStatus,SizeRemaining,Size | Format-List }; TrySection 'Temp folder top-level size' { $paths=@($env:TEMP,(Join-Path $env:windir 'Temp')); @(foreach($p in $paths){ if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){ $items=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $sum=($items | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum; [pscustomobject]@{Path=$p; Exists=$true; TopLevelItems=$items.Count; TopLevelBytes=[int64]$sum} } else { [pscustomobject]@{Path=$p; Exists=$false; TopLevelItems=0; TopLevelBytes=0} } }) | Format-List }; TrySection 'Component store analysis' { if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dism -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('Dism.exe not found at ' + $dism) }; & $dism /Online /Cleanup-Image /AnalyzeComponentStore; Write-Output ('DISM AnalyzeComponentStore exit code: ' + $LASTEXITCODE) }; TrySection 'Large user profile folders sample' { $userRoot=$env:USERPROFILE; $folders='Desktop','Documents','Downloads','Pictures','Videos','AppData\Local\Temp'; @(foreach($f in $folders){ $p=Join-Path $userRoot $f; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){ $items=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $sum=($items | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum; [pscustomobject]@{Path=$p; Exists=$true; TopLevelItems=$items.Count; TopLevelBytes=[int64]$sum} } else { [pscustomobject]@{Path=$p; Exists=$false; TopLevelItems=0; TopLevelBytes=0} } }) | Format-List }

phases.prompt: Collect read-only disk, temp, component store, and high-level user folder evidence. Do not delete files.
phases.completion: Storage cleanup opportunities and risks are captured.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; function Section($n){ Write-Output ('== ' + $n + ' ==') }; function TrySection($n,[scriptblock]$b){ Section $n; try { & $b } catch { Write-Output ('[warning] ' + $n + ' unavailable: ' + $_.Exception.Message) } }; TrySection 'Installed desktop apps sample' { Get-ItemProperty HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*,HKLM:\Software\WOW6432Node\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\*,HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall\* -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName } | Select-Object DisplayName,DisplayVersion,Publisher,InstallDate,EstimatedSize,UninstallString | Sort-Object DisplayName | Select-Object -First 240 | Format-List }; TrySection 'Appx packages sample' { Get-AppxPackage -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { -not $_.IsFramework } | Select-Object Name,Publisher,Version,PackageFullName | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -First 180 | Format-List }; TrySection 'Winget installed apps sample' { winget list --disable-interactivity --accept-source-agreements 2>$null | Select-Object -First 220 }; TrySection 'Startup commands' { Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Command,Location,User | Format-List }; TrySection 'Enabled non-Microsoft scheduled tasks sample' { Get-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.TaskPath -notlike '\Microsoft\*' -and $_.State -ne 'Disabled' } | Select-Object TaskPath,TaskName,State | Sort-Object TaskPath,TaskName | Select-Object -First 180 | Format-Table -AutoSize }; TrySection 'Auto services non-Microsoft sample' { Get-CimInstance Win32_Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.StartMode -eq 'Auto' -and $_.PathName -notmatch 'Windows\\System32|Microsoft' } | Select-Object Name,DisplayName,State,StartName,PathName | Select-Object -First 160 | Format-List }; TrySection 'Browser extension folders and policy/proxy clues' { $netsh=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\netsh.exe'; $reg=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\reg.exe'; foreach($exe in @($netsh,$reg)){ if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('Required Windows tool not found: ' + $exe) } }; $paths=@((Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Extensions'),(Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\Extensions'),(Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles')); foreach($p in $paths){ if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){ Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,LastWriteTime | Select-Object -First 120 | Format-List } else { Write-Output ('absent=' + $p) } }; & $netsh winhttp show proxy; Write-Output ('netsh winhttp show proxy exit code: ' + $LASTEXITCODE); Get-ItemProperty 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Internet Settings' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object ProxyEnable,ProxyServer,AutoConfigURL | Format-List; foreach($policyKey in @('HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge','HKLM\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Edge','HKCU\Software\Policies\Google\Chrome','HKLM\Software\Policies\Google\Chrome')){ Write-Output ('-- ' + $policyKey); & $reg query $policyKey /s 2>$null; Write-Output ('reg query exit code: ' + $LASTEXITCODE) } }

phases.prompt: Collect read-only bloatware/adware evidence: installed apps, Appx packages, package-manager list, startup items, scheduled tasks, auto services, browser extension folders, proxy, and browser policy clues.
phases.completion: Bloatware/adware candidates and startup clutter evidence are captured.

phases.prompt: Analyze cleanup, bloatware, adware, startup, proxy, browser policy, and installed software evidence. Separate safe cleanup actions from app removals that require exact user approval. Flag OEM/security/driver/business apps to preserve by default.
phases.completion: Cleanup findings are prioritized and safe boundaries are explicit.

phases.prompt: Ask human or apply access-mode policy before deleting temp files or running Windows component cleanup. Offer restore point when a cleanup may be hard to roll back. Do not remove apps in this workflow unless the user already gave exact approval; recommend Clean Uninstall for exact app removal.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; function Section($n){ Write-Output ('== ' + $n + ' ==') }; $schtasks=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\schtasks.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $schtasks -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('schtasks.exe not found at ' + $schtasks) }; Section 'Disk before cleanup'; Get-Volume | Select-Object DriveLetter,FileSystemLabel,SizeRemaining,Size | Format-List; Section 'Remove old temp files only'; $cutoff=(Get-Date).AddDays(-7); $targets=@($env:TEMP,(Join-Path $env:windir 'Temp')); $removed=0; $skipped=0; foreach($target in $targets){ if([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($target)){ throw 'Temp cleanup target is empty, refusing to delete' }; $dir=Get-Item -LiteralPath $target -Force; if(-not $dir.PSIsContainer){ throw ('Temp cleanup target is not a directory: ' + $target) }; if($dir.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint){ throw ('Temp cleanup target is a reparse point, refusing to follow it: ' + $dir.FullName) }; if($dir.Name -ne 'Temp'){ throw ('Temp cleanup target does not name a Temp directory: ' + $dir.FullName) }; Write-Output ('Target: ' + $dir.FullName); foreach($entry in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir.FullName -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)){ if($entry.LastWriteTime -ge $cutoff){ continue }; if($entry.PSIsContainer){ $recent=@(); try { $recent=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $entry.FullName -Force -Recurse -ErrorAction Stop | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -ge $cutoff } | Select-Object -First 1) } catch { $skipped=$skipped+1; Write-Output ('skipped=' + $entry.FullName + ' reason=subtree not readable: ' + $_.Exception.Message); continue }; if($recent.Count -gt 0){ $skipped=$skipped+1; Write-Output ('skipped=' + $entry.FullName + ' reason=subtree holds files newer than the cutoff'); continue } }; try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $entry.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $removed=$removed+1; Write-Output ('removed=' + $entry.FullName) } catch { $skipped=$skipped+1; Write-Output ('skipped=' + $entry.FullName + ' reason=' + $_.Exception.Message) } } }; Write-Output ('temp_cleanup removed=' + $removed + ' skipped=' + $skipped); Section 'Start Windows component cleanup scheduled task'; & $schtasks /Run /TN '\Microsoft\Windows\Servicing\StartComponentCleanup'; $taskExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('schtasks /Run exit code: ' + $taskExit); Section 'Disk after cleanup request'; Get-Volume | Select-Object DriveLetter,FileSystemLabel,SizeRemaining,Size | Format-List; if($taskExit -ne 0){ throw ('schtasks /Run StartComponentCleanup failed with exit code ' + $taskExit) }

phases.prompt: After approval, remove only temp entries whose whole subtree is older than the cutoff from the user/Windows temp folders, and trigger the supported Windows StartComponentCleanup task. Do not touch Downloads, documents, browser profiles, app data, or exact app removal targets.
phases.completion: Safe cleanup output lists every removed and skipped entry with counts, before/after disk evidence is captured, and the phase fails if a cleanup target or the component cleanup task could not be trusted or run.

arguments.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $schtasks=Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'System32\schtasks.exe'; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $schtasks -PathType Leaf)){ throw ('schtasks.exe not found at ' + $schtasks) }; Write-Output '== Volumes after cleanup =='; Get-Volume | Select-Object DriveLetter,FileSystemLabel,SizeRemaining,Size | Format-List; Write-Output '== Temp folder top-level after cleanup =='; $paths=@($env:TEMP,(Join-Path $env:windir 'Temp')); @(foreach($p in $paths){ if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){ $items=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $p -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $sum=($items | Measure-Object Length -Sum).Sum; [pscustomobject]@{Path=$p; Exists=$true; TopLevelItems=$items.Count; TopLevelBytes=[int64]$sum} } else { [pscustomobject]@{Path=$p; Exists=$false; TopLevelItems=0; TopLevelBytes=0} } }) | Format-List; Write-Output '== Component cleanup task state =='; & $schtasks /Query /TN '\Microsoft\Windows\Servicing\StartComponentCleanup' /V /FO LIST; $queryExit=$LASTEXITCODE; Write-Output ('schtasks /Query exit code: ' + $queryExit); if($queryExit -ne 0){ throw ('schtasks /Query StartComponentCleanup failed with exit code ' + $queryExit) }

phases.prompt: Verify disk space, temp top-level state, and component cleanup task state after cleanup.
phases.completion: Cleanup effect is verified or remaining cleanup debt is visible.

phases.prompt: Review whether cleanup claims are supported by evidence, whether app-removal recommendations are not overstated, and whether protected user data/app categories were preserved.
phases.completion: Quality review passes or lists gaps.

phases.prompt: Create a technician-readable cleanup handoff report with issue/symptoms, evidence collected, storage findings, bloatware/adware candidates, actions/tools used, what was intentionally not removed, verification results, artifacts/logs, cleanup status, residual risk, and recommended next steps such as exact app uninstall workflow or malware scan.
phases.completion: User has an easy-to-read cleanup report.

phases.prompt: Preserve evidence and reports; remove only temporary scratch files created by this workflow.

acceptance_criteria: Read-only cleanup and adware evidence is collected before deletion.
No user documents, Downloads folder, browser profile, or app data are removed automatically.
Safe cleanup is approval-gated and uses Windows-supported cleanup paths.
Bloatware/adware candidates are recommendations unless exact app removal is approved.
Report clearly says what changed and what still needs user decision.
